required_test: Same frozen inputs produce exactly existing publish_object payload bytes/default JSON+LF, canonical inventory SHA, complete summary/bounds and all row/control domains; accepted builder proofs remain algorithm-specific evidence.
Reject self-signed/rehashed payload+marker/certificate not exactly anchored by the root admission; reject caller dict/boolean/fake seal, wrong PID or pickled handle.
Reject wrong source commit/code hash/design/protocol/part/stage/model/revision/tokenizer/numeric profile/tiling/finish reserve, stale original inputs or current protected registries.

Selected requires complete actual selected bundle and matching full numeric backing reference; missing/partial/stale/changed axis order or backing fails. Prefit binds selected=None and never reads selection/calibration.

Reject missing/extra files, partial publication/no marker, symlink/path substitution, marker-only re-sign, same-size content replacement with restored mtime, or transient rewrite during parse. Hash exactly the bytes parsed.

After load, immutable graph/requirement identity cannot be replaced or mutated. Late backing mutation leaves the value unchanged but fails before final pilot publication. Never silently use an old file after failed reauthentication.

CPU preparation cannot satisfy current source/protection/ledger/reservation/budget/allocation/lease checks. Cancellation/changed mapping/expired or shortened allocation after preparation fails at the original guards.
Mismatch in actual post-load geometry or kernel/numeric identity fails before the first numerical forward even when CPU metadata/labels look valid.
Production pilot without prepared data fails before model load; no lazy builder fallback. Preparation API cannot construct/load a model. Startup/lease accounting includes all receiver costs.

Fresh source-bound nine prefit cases and complete aggregate must use prepared path, preserve all original positive/replay/packing/serial/dummy/sender/control checks and actual reconciliation. No old63 selected admission inheritance; selected gate waits for its dependency.

Record actual cold/warm receiver and final hash costs and full retained peak; if the unchanged paired cap/capacities are not supported, fail admission rather than dropping checks or treating metadata guards as zero cost.

Advance the real test clock/shorten the fake allocation or cancel the fixture reservation during metadata read; the new post-reader fresh model_guard must reject before the model loader is called. Production clocks/loaders are never injected.

Reject missing/wrong-source/wrong-artifact receiver measurement, understated metadata RAM/retention, unbacked root capacity or actual allocation too small. Producer peak cannot stand in for parsed/frozen-reader peak; original full-target/M2 bounds stay exact.
